case: 流束换算台: ADCP 波束速度、姿态旋转与质量层级
narrative: hydrology team recomputes instrument, ship and earth frame velocities from raw beam velocity, attitude, bottom track and transducer configuration

boundary_scenarios.expected: 3-beam solution only; no 4-beam value fabricated; event single_beam_failure

boundary_scenarios.trigger: heading 359 deg -> 1 deg between bracketing samples
boundary_scenarios.expected: interpolation on unwrapped heading; event heading_unwrap

boundary_scenarios.trigger: attitude samples missing between t=8.0 and t=10.0 (gap 2.0s > max 1.5s)
boundary_scenarios.expected: no interpolation across the gap; earth transform blocked; values stay in instrument frame with diagnostic; event attitude_gap
cand-beam3 and cand-beam4 kept as separate candidates, never merged; event three_beam_ambiguity
only ship_vel/earth_vel/profile nodes recomputed; beam_qc/instr_vel copied as still-valid; event param_revision

boundary_scenarios.trigger: variant branch applies attitude before mounting correction
boundary_scenarios.expected: different fingerprint for identical inputs; order string and version recorded in fingerprint_components event

boundary_scenarios.trigger: depth beyond max range / low correlation / amplitude out of range
boundary_scenarios.expected: cells excluded but kept in place with diagnostics; event invalid_depth_cell / cell_excluded

invariants: 3-beam and 4-beam solutions are never merged into one value
attitude interpolation never crosses a time gap
transform order, beam geometry and magnetic declination version all enter the derived fingerprint
ambiguous states keep every legal candidate instead of collapsing to a single answer
